comment: The pinned benchmark corpus. perf-session.sh measures an engine commit with
the benchmarks named here, taken from `ref`, instead of the ones that commit
Why: without this, benchmark drift is confounded with engine change. Two
commits whose bench_test.go differs are not measuring the same thing, and a
commit predating a benchmark cannot be measured by it at all — which is what
makes historical re-measurement impossible and forces an epoch break every
Only _test.go files and tests/scripts fixtures may appear in `files`.
bench-corpus.sh refuses anything else, because overlaying engine source
would measure a different engine than the commit under test.
Version history — numbers are comparable only within a version:
v3  escape the accumulators in the pkg/vm micros (IsObject, ToInteger,
GetOwn) via runtime.KeepAlive. Under v2 the IsObject loop body was
dead-code eliminated at commits where IsObject inlines and retained
where it does not, so v2 IsObject deltas across that boundary
overstate the gain and must not be compared against v3.
